title: <name> and the Secrets of Rajgarh Fort

pages.text: It was a bright, sunny morning when <name> climbed the winding path up to Rajgarh Fort with his family. The ancient stones glowed golden in the sun, and the air smelled of dry earth and blooming marigolds. As they explored the ramparts, <name> noticed curious symbols carved into the walls — spirals, stars, and little animals that seemed to move when he blinked.
“Look, Papa! Someone left messages here!” <name> whispered, excitement sparkling in his eyes.

Following the carvings, he discovered a narrow tunnel hidden behind a loose stone. As he crawled inside, he heard a familiar squawk. A colorful parrot perched on a ledge, tilting its head and repeating a riddle in Hindi: 'सच्चा मित्र वही जो डर में साथ खड़ा हो।' (A true friend stands by you in fear.)

<name> grinned and solved the puzzle by matching the symbols on the walls to his grandfather’s stories about brave soldiers and loyal friends. Suddenly, a stone door blocked the tunnel. Thinking quickly, <name> pressed a carved pattern on the wall — the door creaked open to reveal a small chamber with more carvings: scenes of friendship, teamwork, and courage from long ago.
He ran back to his family, eyes wide. “The fort isn’t just old stones,” he said, “it’s full of lessons about being brave and caring for friends!”

From that day on, <name> never looked at history the same way. Every old wall, every carved stone seemed to whisper tales of courage, friendship, and clever thinking — secrets waiting for the curious and brave to discover.
